label: Trim
help: Choose nets, planes and bodies that cut each other. The pieces inside the scan become one body; clicking a piece removes it, clicking a faded piece keeps it. Push nets past the planes in the freeform net first.
nothing: Create an open net, a freeform patch or a body first.

automatic.label: Automatic
automatic.description: Keep the pieces inside the scan again; the clicks are dropped.

hints.pick: Click a piece: remove it or keep it again
